lead.headline: Lost by 46.6; Week 8 opens with byes at QB and TE
lead.deck: 1-6. Daniels into the QB slot today and claim Loveland before 01:00 Wednesday; Golden and Jacobs are checked Thursday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Furia Regia won 144.16 to 97.52: Likely caught two for 12 in McCarthy's first Giants start (3.2), Garrett Wilson had 4.6 and the Jets D/ST 1. Gordon's 17.3 sat on the bench — 12.7 points left — but no lineup closes 46.6. Bloodsports are 1-6. Week 8 opens with Stroud at quarterback on a Houston bye and Likely at tight end on a Giants bye. Jayden Daniels goes in today, and Colston Loveland — Chicago's tight end now that Cole Kmet is out for the season — is the claim, Stroud the drop. Matthew Golden missed Monday's estimated practice with shoulder and foot injuries before Thursday's game; Pickens covers him. Josh Jacobs carries a day-to-day tag no report explains; Gordon covers him.

doFirst.deck: Loveland for Stroud. Golden and Jacobs checked Thursday 16:45.
doFirst.note: Loveland costs priority (5th, never resets) — the one kind of claim it should buy. Henry is the free-agent fallback.
